mission: Map reusable Prometeo capabilities that Alumnos / pagina docente should consume rather than duplicate, preserving exact authority boundaries and avoiding new page-local owners.

authority_snapshot.concurrency_note: main advanced materially during this read-only archaeology because many /wc workers were claiming and starting isolated lanes. Conclusions below are tied to exact reopenable source refs and do not promote Current, Human Accepted, or Served authority.

surface_truth_boundary.finding: In the inspected Catalog/Current authority there is no direct composite page-current named alumnos-teacher. Alumnos is represented by individual catalog pages and shared runtimes. Therefore the teacher surface should be treated as a composition/orchestration layer unless a sibling current-truth RETURN supplies newer exact authority.
do_not_infer: Absence from this scoped inspection is not proof that no historical teacher-page artifact exists.
A catalog SOURCE_REFERENCE or TESTED_CANDIDATE runtime is not Human Accepted or Served merely because it is reusable.

capabilities.integration_rule: Teacher surface is a child/page projection inside the one global host. Route results through host page/work-item routes rather than mounting a page-local shell.

capabilities.integration_rule: Page-specific change continuity belongs in the existing Page Change Thread/Feed. Durable RETURN is the result authority; the disposable worker chat is not project memory.

capabilities.integration_rule: Use claims/runs/returns, context receipts, stale recovery and scoped workers. A teacher page can launch work through existing execution contracts but should not own a new scheduler or continuity plane.
Reuse its BYTES->...->REOPENABLE pipeline, authority/privacy filtering, contradiction fail-closed behavior and explained deterministic selection. Do not invent page-specific context truth rules.
Compile scoped context from work item + Foundry + catalog target with privacy propagation, reopen handles and byte budget. Do not build an ad-hoc teacher-page prompt assembler.

The inspected executable responsibilities are already split across Context Foundry, Context Packs, Agent Runtime context receipts and page/work-item authorities. A generic Prompt OS archaeology lane is already active; consume its RETURN instead of defining a teacher-local monolith.

capabilities.authority_state: V26 stable class-player best-known/rollback donor; V37 selective best-known donor for laser transform tracking and recovered object/board capabilities; whole V37 UX is not Human Accepted
capabilities.integration_rule: Prefer capability-level donor selection. Preserve V26 as stable fallback; import only proven V37 capabilities where needed and gate them independently.

Reuse compact class state + append-only evidence semantics only behind candidate gates. Resolve its default PageKit v37 policy against the stable V26 capability authority before product-facing promotion.

Reuse compact per-student/world progress state plus separate append-only evidence rather than creating teacher-page copies of student state. Teacher views should project or query student-owned state through an explicit contract.

Resolve page_id/source/writable target from Catalog, current/candidate pointers from Current Graph, and best-known/rollback donors from Capability Registry. Never freeze a teacher-local clone as authority.

non_obvious_findings.finding: The inspected current authority describes Alumnos through individual page identities plus shared runtimes, not a direct alumnos-teacher Current artifact. The safe teacher surface shape is therefore a composition/orchestration projection unless newer sibling truth evidence says otherwise.

Classes Runtime v2 defaults pageKitVersion=v37, while Capability Registry keeps pagekit.stable_class_player best-known/rollback at V26 and V37 is a selective donor. A consumer must not mistake a candidate runtime default for product authority.

Prompt/Context responsibilities are already distributed across Foundry, Context Packs, Runtime receipts and page/work-item truth. The Prompt OS label should compose these and await the already-claimed archaeology lane, not create a second context architecture.
Existing Page Change durable RETURN/thread semantics plus P4 Capture mean the teacher surface can preserve work without treating worker chats as persistent product state.

contradictions_and_gates.evidence_b: lineage/CAPABILITY_REGISTRY.json keeps stable class player at v26 and laser tracking at v37
contradictions_and_gates.resolution: Do not resolve by version number. Select capabilities explicitly; keep v26 rollback donor until independent acceptance proves a broader cutover.
Use exact main source refs for this return and label epoch lag; do not use a stale published epoch as proof that main is unchanged.

deduplication.reason: No new proposal is warranted from this lane. The Alumnos DISCOVER/INTENT/PLAN/RISK/TRUTH/UX sibling lanes are already claimed, as are generic Page Change, Prompt OS and Worker Fabric archaeology lanes. Their durable RETURNs should be consumed before creating successor work.

integration_guidance.shape: Thin teacher orchestration/projection over existing owners, not a new subsystem family.
read_side: Catalog/Current/Capability Registry for identity and authority
student/class runtimes only under their candidate status
P4 Capture and Page Change Thread for durable user/work continuity
write_side: write only through the owning capability contract
persist teacher-specific presentation state separately from student/class truth
route disposable-worker outputs back through durable Page Change RETURN/thread contracts
integration_guidance.promotion_gate: Any product-facing integration must preserve single-owner invariants and independently verify candidate capabilities; this reuse map itself grants no Current/Human Accepted/Served promotion.

privacy: PUBLIC_COORDINATION_METADATA_AND_CODE_REFERENCES_ONLY; no student private payloads, notes, recordings, credentials or personal state persisted.
